verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a speech API platform, but the evidence never documents a scheduler, cron, or recurring-workflow feature. Batch processing covers one-off job submission rather than a recurring schedule. Kubernetes 'automated orchestration' is a host-platform capability, and admin-token automation is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
